name: Castelli
verdict: Castelli is a brand of MVC Group (Manifattura Valcismon), an Italian sportswear group that says it is family owned since 1946. Nothing found.
note: Kit supplier of Soudal Quick-Step per the 2026 kit launch; listed as partner per the convention for kit manufacturers. Alantra advised the Cremonese family on the sale of a 40% stake in Manifattura Valcismon to Italian private-equity investor Equinox (deal note, Dec 2018, alantra.com), so the group's own 'family owned' wording is partial; Equinox is a private fund, tier unaffected.
